as_told.title: Stuckelberger: CERN physicists told her beings come through portals

plain: Astrid Stuckelberger, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says physicists from CERN told her that beings are coming in and out through portals. CERN is the big European physics laboratory near Geneva, Switzerland, home to a huge particle collider. If it were true, it would mean scientists had opened doorways that something non-human uses, and in a later telling she adds that she knows physicists who are doing very strange experiments.
